ProjectsDone.title: Colombia’s First Legal Subscription Platform
ProjectsDone.description: A SaaS platform providing 24/7 AI-powered legal assistance, monthly subscription plans, and smart scheduling for specialized legal consultations.
about: Legal Aid is Colombia’s first legal subscription service — an innovative platform built on the belief that justice should be a right for all, not a privilege for the few who can afford it.

In a region marked by deep inequalities, Legal Aid disrupts the traditional legal model by offering high-quality legal advice and representation through affordable monthly plans — without hidden fees or economic barriers.
Born from a commitment to more humane justice, Legal Aid blends technology, artificial intelligence, and people-first design to provide legal support to both individuals and businesses.

The platform delivers a complete digital legal ecosystem, including a 24/7 AI legal assistant, specialized lawyer scheduling, legal case management, and access to multiple legal practice areas from a single user-friendly interface.
solution: We developed a complete ecosystem using Next.js, Supabase, and PostgreSQL, deployed on Vercel for high scalability and uptime.
Implemented a 24/7 AI-powered legal assistant capable of answering legal questions, analyzing documents, and drafting legal texts in real time.
Built a legal plan subscription system that offers a defined number of consultations per practice area, such as family, civil, labor, criminal, and consumer law.
Created a smart scheduling system for booking appointments with specialized lawyers, integrated with Google Calendar for virtual or in-person meetings.
Developed a legal case management module that allows users to document legal processes, upload files, track case stages, generate reports, and assign attorneys.
Included an advanced admin dashboard to configure AI knowledge (FAQs, laws, files), manage users, legal areas, metrics, and payment tracking.
Added features for automatic renewals, payment history, co-pay management, and consultation usage tracking by legal line.
features: Legal Subscription Plans by Practice Area
Full Legal Case Management and PDF Reporting
Admin Panel with AI Configuration and Content Control
Real-Time Metrics and User Analytics Dashboard

ProjectsDone.title: Personalized Pet Care Services
ProjectsDone.description: A visually engaging and user-friendly landing page for FITPup, a premium pet care service provider.
about: FITPup is a provider of personalized pet care services focused on animal health and well-being. With over 25 years of experience, they offer services such as walking, training, nutrition plans, and transportation in Palm Beach and its surroundings.
FITPup is located in Palm Beach and serves clients throughout the surrounding area, providing exclusive services to ensure the well-being of pets.
Their mission is to provide high-quality care with a personalized approach, ensuring that each pet receives the best possible care tailored to their specific needs.
FITPup combines professionalism with a passion for animals, creating a community of pet owners who trust their services to improve their furry companions' quality of life.
solution: For the creation of the landing page, we worked closely with the FITPup team to capture the essence of their brand and convey their message clearly and attractively.
A fresh and dynamic design was chosen, incorporating animated visual elements, vibrant colors, and an intuitive structure to enhance user experience.

The landing page features an eye-catching hero section, a frequently asked questions (FAQ) section, a carousel of highlighted services, and a multimedia gallery with photos and videos of pets cared for by FITPup.
We implemented a blog powered by Sanity, allowing FITPup to share tips and updates on pet care.

A multi-step online form was developed for users to request services. The form guides pet owners through different stages: acceptance of terms and conditions with a digital signature, owner and contact information, veterinary details, and pet profile registration, including vaccination documents.
For form submission management, we used Resend, ensuring FITPup receives all information in real time, including attached files and the client's signature.
Optimizations were applied to improve loading speed, making it fast and efficient across all devices.
features: Multi-step Online Form with Digital Signature

ProjectsDone.title: Connecting Communities, Empowering Local
ProjectsDone.description: Hyperlocal community platform that connects neighbors, local businesses, and professionals within the same neighborhood or city in Colombia. It blends a community feed and location-based discovery with a loyalty system for businesses: digital coupons and stamp cards.
about: KOMU is the hyperlocal community platform that connects neighbors, local businesses, and professionals from the same neighborhood or city in one place.
Inspired by the idea of a “Nextdoor for Colombia and Latin America,” KOMU is redesigned and adapted to the region’s reality: in Spanish, with local geography and a focus on neighborhood commerce.
Beyond a neighborhood social network, it integrates real business tools from day one —catalog, metrics, members, and plans— along with its own loyalty system based on digital coupons and stamp cards.
It operates in Colombia with a vision to expand across Latin America, under the tagline “Connecting communities, empowering local.”
solution: We designed and developed the KOMU experience as a hyperlocal community platform, centered on proximity-based discovery and local commerce.
We built a clear architecture by sections and roles: a community feed, a map and location-based search (near me, my city, explore), and profiles for neighbors, businesses, and professionals.
We defined the business module with profile, product and service catalog, visibility metrics (visits and WhatsApp clicks), team members, and plans.
We designed the “Benefits” loyalty system: redeemable coupons and a configurable digital stamp card (between 3 and 12 stamps) with a customizable reward for each business.
We developed personal and business onboarding, with geolocation by Colombian departments and cities, and avatars.
We crafted a cohesive visual identity and a Spanish (es-CO) interface focused on closeness, trust, and community.
The structure was prepared to scale to new cities and support regional expansion across Latin America.
features: Community Feed with Category and Location Filters
Profiles for Neighbors, Businesses, and Professionals

ProjectsDone.title: Your Business Already Works. Your Marketing Doesn’t.
ProjectsDone.description: Website for Nodo, a digital marketing agency in Bogotá and Villavicencio. A conversion-focused Next.js landing page with the portfolio managed in Sanity, a contact form that lands in the inbox through Resend and opens WhatsApp with the message pre-written, and an SEO, AEO and GEO layer so AI assistants cite it too.
about: Nodo is a full-service digital marketing agency based in Bogotá, with operations in Villavicencio and the Meta region as well. Its tagline: “We connect ideas with results.”

It works with businesses that already make money but have no marketing team: clinics, restaurants, real estate firms, gyms, medical practices and construction companies. Hence the line that opens the site: “Your business already works. Your marketing doesn’t.”

The promise is to handle all of it. They go to the client’s location, shoot with their own crew, edit, publish and run the paid media on Meta, TikTok, Google and LinkedIn. The client writes no scripts, edits nothing and publishes nothing.
Every month they deliver a one-page report with three numbers —how many people saw you, how many wrote to you and what each of those people cost— with no jargon and no thirty-page attachments.

Nodo is two people: Natalia Melo Sánchez, who runs content and community, and Juan Pablo Pineda, who runs production and paid media. That is precisely their pitch: the client talks to whoever does the work, not to an account executive.
solution: We designed and built the entire site in Next.js with the App Router, React and TypeScript: the long conversion home page plus the about, projects, project detail, contact, thank-you and privacy pages.

We shaped the home page as a sales journey rather than a service catalogue: the problem (“None of this is your fault”), the team the business is missing, the three-step process —we talk, we shoot, we measure—, the real cases, the differentiator, the plans with prices in plain sight, and the questions people ask before signing.

We set up Sanity as the content management system. Projects, images, copy and every case’s data are edited from the Studio without touching code, and a webhook revalidates the Next.js cache so changes go live immediately.

We created the projects section with a dedicated page per client: a fact sheet with account, industry, city, year and website, the story of what had to be solved, and the gallery of footage shot on location.

We developed the five-field contact form with a double outcome: the submission reaches Nodo’s inbox through Resend and, at the same time, opens WhatsApp with the message already written so the prospect only has to hit send.

We hardened that form with a honeypot field and validation against spam, and added the data-processing consent checkbox required by Colombia’s Law 1581 of 2012, with its privacy page and a thank-you page kept out of search engines.

We covered technical SEO end to end: per-page metadata, canonicals, es-CO hreflang, code-generated sitemap and robots.txt, images served in modern formats through the Next image optimizer, custom Open Graph, manifest and icons.

We implemented AEO and GEO, where visibility is actually decided today: Organization, ProfessionalService and LocalBusiness structured data with address, opening hours, team and a plan catalogue with prices, plus a FAQPage block covering the ten frequently asked questions.

We also published an llms.txt file with all of the agency’s information in plain text —what it does, where, plans, prices, team, clients and terms— and opened robots.txt to GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended and the rest, so ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Gemini can quote Nodo with correct data instead of making it up.

We defined the on-screen identity: Nodo purple, accent yellow and a cream background, uppercase headlines in a heavy sans, serif body copy, scroll-triggered animations and a full-screen menu with a QR code to WhatsApp.

We tuned the mobile version screen by screen, because almost all of the agency’s traffic arrives from Instagram and TikTok: the floating WhatsApp button and the free-consultation call to action are always within a thumb’s reach.
features: Next.js with App Router, React and TypeScript
Content and Projects Editable from Sanity CMS
Contact Form Delivered by Email with Resend
Submission That Opens WhatsApp with the Message Ready
Plans and Prices with Structured Data
llms.txt File for AI Assistants (AEO and GEO)
Code-Generated Sitemap, Robots and Open Graph
Colombian Data Protection Law 1581 of 2012 Compliance

ProjectsDone.title: Dog Daycare & Boarding in Palm Beach
ProjectsDone.description: High-impact website for a premium daycare and boarding service focused on small groups, trust, 24/7 supervision, and a “vacation-for-dogs” experience in Palm Beach.
about: PetFriends is a dog daycare & boarding service in Palm Beach focused on small groups to ensure personalized, calm, and safe care.
The brand communicates a tropical, clean, and friendly vibe—where owners feel at ease and dogs feel like they’re on vacation.
Unlike high-volume facilities, PetFriends prioritizes constant supervision, affection, and a home-like environment—never a “kennel” experience.

The website needed to build trust at first glance, highlight key differentiators (small-group care, vaccine requirements, temperament evaluation, 24/7 supervision), and drive bookings through clear CTAs.
solution: We designed and developed a modern, fully responsive landing page with a soft pastel aesthetic (signature pink) and a clean layout to elevate a premium brand feel.
We built a high-impact hero section with a strong visual centerpiece and conversion-focused CTAs (“Book a Stay” / “Contact Us”), optimized for fast and intuitive navigation.
We implemented dedicated service sections (Daycare / Boarding) emphasizing safety, supervision, and a home-like experience aligned with the message “Where pets feel at home.”
We created a visual gallery with custom-shaped cards and a dynamic layout, reinforcing a friendly and aspirational look & feel.
We added an accordion-style FAQ module to address key objections (required vaccines, supervision, grouping by size/temperament, emergencies, cancellations).
We developed a booking flow with a multi-step form to collect owner details, pet information, behavior/socialization, requested services, and dates in an organized way.
We optimized performance and technical SEO (efficient loading, optimized images, clean section structure, and simple navigation) to ensure speed and a great mobile experience.
features: Clear CTAs (Book a Stay / Contact Us)
Complete data capture: vaccines, vet info, behavior, and services

ProjectsDone.title: Good Samaritan Home Foundation
ProjectsDone.description: A heartfelt, responsive landing page for a non-profit organization with over 60 years of mission serving the elderly, the sick, and people in vulnerable conditions.
about: The Good Samaritan Home Foundation, located in Cartago, Valle del Cauca (Colombia), has offered a dignified home, comprehensive care, and spiritual support to elderly people, the sick, and those in vulnerable or abandoned conditions for decades.

Its story began in 1964 with the arrival of the missionary team from the Diocese of Manchester (New Hampshire, USA) and the tireless service of nurse Claire Aimée Ange Aucoin — affectionately known as Clarita. In 1998, her lifelong mission became a legally recognized foundation sustained by faith, international solidarity, and the generosity of the local community.

The landing page was designed to convey the home’s legacy of compassion, its current impact — more than 170 people cared for daily — and the importance of ongoing support through donations, volunteering, and partnerships.
With a warm and human-centered design, the site honors the story of the Home and makes it easier for visitors to connect emotionally and contribute to the cause.
solution: We designed a narrative-driven landing page showcasing the Home’s history, Clarita’s mission, and its spiritual foundation through an elegant and visual timeline.

The structure includes multiple sections: a Hero area with Clarita’s quote and donation CTA, full history, mission and vision, daily activities, impact metrics, ways to help, and direct contact channels.
The design is fully responsive and optimized for mobile, tablet, and desktop, ensuring accessibility for donors and visitors worldwide.
We strategically highlighted key donation information — bank account details, tax ID (NIT), WhatsApp contact, email, and physical location — to make supporting the mission simple and transparent.
The visual identity uses a soft, faith-inspired color palette that conveys warmth, trust, and sincerity, aligned with the foundation’s humanitarian and spiritual essence.
We structured all content to support future bilingual expansion (Spanish/English), enabling broader communication with international partners and donors.
features: Hero section with inspirational quote and donation CTA
Historical timeline highlighting 60+ years of service
Clear presentation of mission, vision, and values
Impact section with real-time beneficiary statistics
‘How to Help’ section with donation and volunteer options
Direct WhatsApp contact button for instant communication
Basic SEO optimization for greater reach
Multilingual support (English and Spanish) for international visitors
